name: BloodLust
source:
A desperately lonely college student yearning for color, a sinful girl with a sharp tongue and even sharper teeth, and a chance encounter in moonlight.
Story about lies, connections, and trying to find happiness in a world intent on giving you none.

[From [url=https://ashenlotus.itch.io/bloodlust]itch.io[/url]]
